chunks: Then it was said: 'O earth, swallow your water; and O sky, desist.' And the water subsided, and the decree was accomplished. The ark came to rest on Al-Judi, and it was said: 'Away with the people who were unjust.'

key_terms.أَقْلِعِي: Desist/Stop (command to the sky to stop raining)
key_terms.ابْلَعِي: Swallow (command to the earth to absorb the water)
key_terms.الْجُودِيِ: Al-Judi (Mount Judi, where the Ark rested)

ai.seo_question: What happened to the water and the Ark after the flood ended?
ai.summary: This verse marks the definitive end of the Noahic flood, emphasizing divine sovereignty over natural elements as the earth swallows the water and the sky ceases its rain. In Shia exegesis, the Ark's resting place on Mount Judi is often viewed as a symbol of stability and salvation for the faithful, contrasting with the ruin of the unjust. The phrase 'Baqdan' (a pronouncement of doom) underscores the finality of God's judgment against those who rejected the prophetic message.
